signature.one_line: Question-hook comparison test: front-loaded roll-call cuts, then repeated identical POV test rounds under a one-word-at-a-time uppercase white caption rail.
unique_devices: One-word caption rail: every spoken word (function words too) as a single small UPPERCASE heavy geometric word, 42 px, +0.05em, fixed at 68.5 % height in every shot, hard-cut swap 0-7 frames after the word, no animation
Product roll-call: as contenders are named, flash each for 10-12 frames (4 shots in ~45 frames), captions dropped during the flashes

Object-pinned type-on spec label tracked to the handheld product: white square grows from a dot (6 frames), characters type in right-to-left with collapsing letter-spacing (~22 frames), delete right-to-left on exit (~9 frames)
Test ladder: identical POV framing for each contender, results improving round by round, the hero's take runs longest, ending unresolved with no CTA
signature.why_it_works: A yes/no stakes question opens a loop; front-loaded cuts lock attention, then one repeatable test frame makes rounds comparable while the verdict is withheld.

hook.type: open loop (yes/no stakes question) + pattern interrupt (product roll-call)
hook.first_frame: medium close-up of the speaker holding a handheld mic in a moody LED-backlit set, one uppercase caption word at 68.5 % height

structure.what: stakes question to camera, hero product with pinned spec label, contender fan + 10-12-frame roll-call
location jump outdoors; POV establishes the test target and the rules
contenders 1-2 tested in identical POV framing
contenders 3-4, results improving, raising stakes for the hero
hero product tested in the longest single take with live reaction
unresolved reaction ending, no CTA (invites comments and rewatch)

pacing.note: front-loaded: ~72 cuts/min in the hook, ~12 cuts/min during the test rounds; the one-word caption swaps ~4 times per second; 76 % of cuts are J/L, none on pauses

captions.how: heavy geometric caps 42 px, +0.05em, white, tight soft dark shadow, no box; centre x 50 %, y 68.5 % in every shot; hard cut on 0-7 frames after each spoken word; punctuation stripped, numbers spelled as spoken

motion_graphics.what: object-pinned type-on spec label on the hero product
motion_graphics.how: white square grows from a dot (6 frames), bold geometric ~39 px characters appear right-to-left with collapsing letter-spacing (~22 frames), tracked and scaled with the handheld product under its logo; deletes right-to-left + square shrinks (~9 frames) before the cut

broll_inserts.how: 4 product inserts at 10-12 frames each, hard cuts on motion, no captions
handheld POV of a device screen aimed at the same target; device zoom UI visible; 90-300-frame takes, hero longest

layout.how: no splits or frames; captions float over footage

camera.what: locked MCU indoors, handheld POV outdoors
camera.how: no digital punch-ins; all zoom is the device's own, shown on screen

transitions.what: hard cuts on hand / device motion
transitions.how: motion blur hides the cut (detector reads 80 % as soft); voice runs through, 76 % J/L
hard cut to a wide shot, resets attention

captions_spec.punctuation: stripped (no commas, full stops or question marks); apostrophes kept (LET'S)
captions_spec.numbers: spelled out as spoken and captioned word by word (e.g. '10x' -> TEN / TIMES)

grouping.sync: one word per caption, replaced on each spoken word (function words included: THE, CAN, SO)
grouping.gaps: no captions during the fast product roll-call inserts (10-12-frame shots) or on a wordless pointing / establishing shot

layout.on_1080x1920: same 9:16 canvas: centre at x 540 px, y 1315 px

word.font_class: geometric sans, black/extra-bold, wide caps (pointed A apex, round C/O, geometric S)

closest_match.google: Poppins Black (alt: Montserrat Black, wider caps)

word.k_note: all caps, no descenders -> k 0.73; formula 1.56 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 41 px; render-verified with Poppins 900 + 0.05em tracking: 42 px (ACTUALLY 1.61 % H / 22.7 % W at 43 px; WORST 1.56 / 14.9 at 41 px)
word.calibration_note: ACTUALLY measured over a dark shirt (clean); WORST over a bright orange object/skin (same ink height, consistent)
word.shadow: tight soft dark shadow hugging the letters (darkens a flat olive background from ~84 to ~57 grey within 2 px of the ink, gone by ~6 px at 720p): ~0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.55) at 1920 (estimated)

animation.entry: hard cut: the new word is full size and full opacity on its first frame (no scale / fade / slide)
animation.timing: on the spoken word: 0-7 frames after the transcript word start (never early); one stretch runs ~12-15 frames late
animation.exit: hard cut when the next word replaces it; disappears with the picture cut into the roll-call

other_text_spec.when: second hook shot (hero product held to the lens), ~77 frames
other_text_spec.text: '■ Label here': solid white square (4.2 % W x 2.34 % H, a square ~45 px at 1080) then a short mixed-case spec label in a bold geometric sans (closest Poppins 700, ~39 px at 1920, tracking 0.05em at rest), white #FFFFFF, no shadow
other_text_spec.position: pinned just under the product's logo: square left edge x 37.5 % W, text x 43.8-63.8 % W, centre y 58.5 % H; it moves and scales with the handheld product (text width grows ~20 -> 22 % W as the product nears the lens)
other_text_spec.size_note: spec label ink 1.41 % H, k 0.73, ~37-39 px at 1920
other_text_spec.animation: square grows from a dot at its bottom-left into place over ~6 frames; characters then appear right-to-left with very wide letter-spacing that collapses to normal, settled after ~22 frames; exit over ~9 frames: characters delete right-to-left while the square shrinks to a dot, gone before the cut

other_text_spec.text: the devices' own zoom readouts and mode labels are part of the footage, not added graphics

style.look_intent: warm, mid-contrast, natural saturation; moody low-key LED-backlit intro (cool rim light, warm skin) then bright natural daylight outdoors

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic: speech-gap level ~0 dB, continuous bed or ambience under the VO); upbeat, unobtrusive
sfx: hits / whooshes on most hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.8), especially the roll-call flashes
optional soft ticks as the pinned label types on

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: comparing several products or options on one repeatable test
most footage is POV / hands-on demo with the speaker off camera
a fast talker needs minimal caption chrome that never covers the product
the concept is a yes/no question with a reveal at the end
avoid_when: brand colour emphasis or keyword highlighting is needed in captions
a calm, reflective talking-head piece (one-word swaps feel frantic)
there is no physical product or test to show
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B27 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B27.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the footage at 68.5 % height, helped by the tight shadow)
- {{TEXT}}      caption words and pinned label          default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    none (no emphasis colour; do not add one) default none
- {{ACCENT_2}}  none                                     default none
- {{SURFACE}}   none                                     default none
- {{CARD_BG}}   pinned-label square                       default #FFFFFF (same as {{TEXT}})
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} caption words                         default Poppins 900 (heavy geometric caps; Montserrat Black slightly wider)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    pinned spec label                     default Poppins 700
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown
- {{LOGO}}      not shown (the label pins under the product's own logo)

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken, ALL UPPERCASE. Strip commas, full stops and question marks; keep apostrophes (LET'S). Spell numbers as spoken (e.g. "10x" -> TEN, TIMES).
2. Exactly ONE word on screen at a time; every spoken word captioned (including THE, CAN, SO). Never two words, never two lines.
3. Type: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 42 px, letter-spacing +0.05em, {{TEXT}}, no stroke, no box, tight soft dark shadow 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.55).
4. Position: centred horizontally (x 540 px), vertical centre 68.5 % of height (y ~1315 px), the same spot in every shot.
5. Animation: hard cut in at full size and opacity 0-7 frames after the word's transcript start (never early); hard cut out when the next word replaces it. No fade, pop, scale, slide, highlight or idle motion.
6. Drop captions during 10-12-frame product roll-call inserts and on wordless pointing / establishing shots.

OTHER TEXT
7. Object-pinned spec label when the hero product is held to camera (~77 frames): a {{CARD_BG}} square (~45x45 px) then a short spec label ("Label here") in {{FONT_BODY}} ~39 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0.05em, no shadow, pinned just under the product's logo (reference: square x 37.5 %, text x 44-64 %, centre y 58.5 %) and tracked so it moves and scales with the object. Square grows from a dot at its bottom-left over 6 frames; characters appear right-to-left with very wide letter-spacing collapsing to normal over ~22 frames; exit: characters delete right-to-left while the square shrinks to a dot over ~9 frames, before the cut.
8. No title cards, lower thirds, stickers, CTA or end card.

EDIT DEVICES
9. Hook: yes/no stakes question in the first word; ~9 cuts in the first 300 frames, including a roll-call of each contender at 10-12 frames as it is named. Then relax to ~12 cuts/min.
10. Body: identical POV framing for every contender's round; cut on hand/device motion (motion blur hides the cut); voice continuous across cuts (J/L). Give the hero the longest take; end on an unresolved reaction, no CTA.

GRADE
11. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, mid-contrast, natural saturation; moody LED-backlit intro, bright natural daylight for the test rounds.

AUDIO
12. Light continuous bed or ambience under the VO; a hit/whoosh on most hard cuts and every roll-call flash. Master to about -14.1 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the caption "ACTUALLY" (and then "WORST") over a dark area and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.35,0.66,0.65,0.72 --ink "{{TEXT}}:45"
   Required at the default font: "ACTUALLY" ink 1.56 % ±0.5 of height and 23.2 % ±2 of width; "WORST" 1.56 % H, 15.0 % W; centre y 68.5 % ±0.5. With a brand font, compute the expected ink with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py ({{FONT_DISPLAY}}, 42 px, +0.05em) and match it within ±0.5 % H.
